topic: How are link budgets affected when prioritizing high-revenue services versus navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling?
consensus_response: Prioritizing high-revenue services can affect link budgets by causing thermal management issues due to increased power dissipation in the satellite and ground station equipment. This can lead to nonlinearities in power amplifiers, which can degrade signal quality and reduce the effective radiated power (ERP) available for navigation signals. To address this issue, advanced cooling systems and power control techniques may be necessary to maintain the required signal quality and link budget requirements for navigation safety margins, while also considering the power constraints for high-revenue services.
